sloka: गृहीते वर नारीभ्याम् धूयमाने च मूर्धनि ।गन्धर्व अमर सिद्धाः च बहवः परम ऋषयः ॥३-५-१०॥
transliteration: gṛhīte vara nārībhyām dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani ।gandharva amara siddhāḥ ca bahavaḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥3-5-10॥

translations.english: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.
